**About Impel Group**

Impel Group builds, operates, and invests in businesses across multiple sectors through its group companies and internal Venture Studio.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a high\-ownership **Full Stack Developer** to manage and scale existing group platforms while building new products within the Impel Venture Studio.

This role balances ongoing product maintenance and release planning with high\-intensity **AI Sprint Weeks**—where business concepts are rapidly converted into working products, features, or MVPs. You will work closely with product managers, business teams, designers, and engineering resources across the complete product lifecycle (architecture, development, testing, deployment, and post\-release support).

**Key Details**

* **Experience Level:** 3\+ Years in Full Stack Development (or comparable product engineering roles)
* **Work Style:** Hybrid execution (Structured development cycles \+ High\-speed product sprints)

**Key ResponsibilitiesCore Product Engineering \& Lifecycle**

* Build, scale, and maintain responsive web and mobile applications across Impel Group platforms.
* Architect robust front\-end interfaces, back\-end systems, REST APIs, databases, and third\-party integrations.
* Translate complex business and product requirements into clean, production\-ready software.
* Take end\-to\-end feature ownership: **Development → Testing → Deployment → Monitoring → Issue Resolution**.

**Operations, Quality \& Security**

* Collaborate with QA to write unit/integration tests, troubleshoot bugs, and ensure stable production releases.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for reliable, automated, and frequent release cycles.
* Maintain version control via Git and document system architecture and developer workflows.
* Ensure application security, performance optimization, system responsiveness, and data protection standards.
* Maintain and optimize existing server infrastructure, web servers, and third\-party integrations.

**Project Planning \& Visibility**

* Participate actively in product planning, technical feasibility reviews, feature prioritization, and sprint planning.
* Maintain real\-time development and rollout dashboards to provide progress visibility to Project/Product Managers.

**⚡ AI Sprint Weeks (Special Operations)**

Impel Group periodically executes high\-intensity **AI Sprint Weeks** to rapidly prototype, build, and launch new products, automations, or major features.

* **Execution:** Work as part of a dedicated, cross\-functional team utilizing AI\-assisted development tools and rapid prototyping frameworks.
* **Availability:** Extended working hours and availability outside standard office hours are **mandatory** during designated sprint periods.
* **Compensation:** **Additional Sprint Compensation / Incentives** are paid separately for designated Sprint Weeks based on scope, duration, and delivery criteria.
* **Standard Mode:** Outside of Sprint Weeks, the role transitions back to core product releases, scheduled enhancements, system optimizations, and platform maintenance.

**Technical Requirements**

* **Core Stack:** 4\+ years of experience with **JavaScript**, **TypeScript**, **Node.js**, and **React.js**.
* **Front\-End:** Advanced HTML5, CSS3, responsive UI development, and modern front\-end frameworks.
* **Back\-End \& Data:** REST API design, relational databases (**MySQL**), and database schema optimization.
* **BaaS \& Cloud:** Hands\-on experience with **Firebase** (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Push Notifications, Analytics).
* **DevOps \& Tools:** Strong command of **Git**, CI/CD deployment automation, and web servers (**Nginx / Apache**).
* **Security:** Solid understanding of authentication patterns, API security, and data protection practices.
* **AI\-Assisted Engineering (Bonus):** Familiarity with modern AI coding tools (**Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code**, or similar platforms) is a major advantage.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Software Engineering PhD Intern, Summer 2027
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Pursuing a PhD program with a focus in software development or other technical related field.
* Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C\+\+, Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.).
* Experience working in Unix/Linux environments.
* Experience with data structures, algorithms, and software design.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Research experience in algorithms, architecture, artificial intelligence, compilers, database, data mining, distributed systems, machine learning, networking, or systems.
* Programming experience in one or more of the following: C/C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Python Objective C, Go or similar.
* Experience in computer science, with competencies in data structures, algorithms and software design.

**About the job**
-----------------


Join us for a 12\+ week paid internship that offers personal and professional development, an executive speaker series, and community\-building. The Software Engineering Internship program will give you an opportunity to work on complex computer science solutions, develop scalable, distributed software systems, and also collaborate on multitudes of smaller projects that have universal appeal.


Our recruitment team will determine where you fit best based on your resume.


As a Software Engineering Intern, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs.


Software Engineering Intern:


You will be a key player on a dynamic team, driving the development of AI\-integrated software and high\-performance applications. Your primary objective is to design, deploy, and maintain the end\-to\-end infrastructure that sustains our large\-scale systems. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Google’s core needs while evolving your technical expertise in a fast\-paced, real\-world environment.


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at a massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.


Google is and always will be an engineering company. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to address some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large\-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Foster a culture of productivity and innovation by actively supporting your peers and managers. Collaborate across teams to ensure the continued success and evolution of the AI\-driven software and large\-scale systems that define our technical landscape.
* Develop scalable engineering solutions for Google products.
* Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution to effectively solve issues.
* Apply knowledge gained in computer science courses to real world challenges.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
